description: ClickHouse's spec marks no response member required, so createApiKey's answer types `key` and `key.id` optional, and a caller must handle a create without the new key's ID. Both are always present: listApiKeys returns `id` on every key (live, 2026-11-13); Alchemy's ClickHouse Cloud provider created a key, read it back by the `key.id` createApiKey returned and updated it in place (live, 2026-11-12); and ClickHouse's Terraform provider (ClickHouse/terraform-provider-clickhouse at 66ecf4fa, internal/api) decodes `result.key`, whose `id` it stores as the resource ID. Marking ApiKeyPostResponse.key and ApiKey.id required lets callers read the ID without checking for undefined.
